name: MKT_IMP_ATTACHED_DOCUMENTS
description: This is an interface table containing attachment associations with base objects.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch ID corresponds to a job batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Interface Row ID is the unique identifier for the record with in a batch. Combination of BATCH_ID and INTERFACE_ROW_ID will be unique in the interface table.

columns.name: PRODUCT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Product Batch ID corresponds to a job batch in the product specific interface table.

columns.name: PRODUCT_INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Product Interface Row ID is the unique identifier for the record with in a batch. Combination of PRODUCT_BATCH_ID and PRODUCT_INTERFACE_ROW_ID will be unique in the product specific interface table.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Record number indicator in the file.

columns.name: INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the product specific interface table for which the attached document record is associated with.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the attached document record.

columns.name: PK1_VALUE
columns.description: The FND attached document PK1 value

columns.name: PK2_VALUE
columns.description: The FND attached document PK2 value

columns.name: PK3_VALUE
columns.description: The FND attached document PK3 value

columns.name: PK4_VALUE
columns.description: The FND attached document PK4 value

columns.name: PK5_VALUE
columns.description: The FND attached document PK5 value

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_FILE_NAME
columns.description: The source attachment file name.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_FILE_DESC
columns.description: The source attachment file description.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_FILE_TITLE
columns.description: The source attachment file title.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: The source attachment category name.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: The attachment entity name

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document ID for reference

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: File Name Systask Id to store the systask id of the object that is associated while doing the import. It iwll help us to generate the logs like success, error and exception logs
